item.text:
{"source":"import Base

# In a center-inclusive window, B3/S23 is exactly 3 <= nine <= 3 + center.
def life(+nine: U32, center: U32) -> U32:
  Bool.to_u32(Bool.and(
    U32.is_ge(nine, 3),
    U32.is_le(nine, (3 + center : U32))))

# The x-fold: peek east, emit the center, then carry this column west.
def line(
  middle: List<&2, U32>, +north: List<&2, U32>,
  +south: List<&2, U32>, nw: U32, w: U32, sw: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match middle:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +c <> +ct:
      +n = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, north), 0)
      +s = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, south), 0)
      +nt = List.tail(&2, U32, north)
      +st = List.tail(&2, U32, south)
      ne = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, nt), 0)
      e = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, ct), 0)
      se = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, st), 0)
      +nine = (nw + n + ne + w + c + e + sw + s + se : U32)
      life(nine, c) <> line(ct, nt, st, n, c, s)

# The y-fold: cut one row, emit one line, then carry that row north.
def plane(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>,
  north: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+h:
      +middle = List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
      +south = List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width)
      List.append(&2, U32,
        line(middle, north, List.take(&2, U32, south, width), 0, 0, 0),
        plane(h, width, south, middle))

# A dead halo seeds both spatial folds.
def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  plane(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), cells, Nil{})

# The t-fold: zero is identity; each successor composes one spatial step.
def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"Read the board as nested structural folds: line sweeps the x-axis with a carried west column, plane sweeps the y-axis with a carried north row, and evolve folds the same step over time. The local representation counts the center in its 3x3 window, turning B3/S23 into the single interval 3 <= total <= 3 + center; the live center alone widens the accepted total from birth-only 3 to survival totals 3 or 4.","findings":"Confirmed style finding: the prior implementation was coherent but exposed the local rule as a disjunction and did not clearly establish its spatial-to-temporal grammar. This revision replaces that disjunction with the center-controlled interval and names the remaining recursion as x-, y-, and t-folds. Prior semantic review was clean and all runtime observations passed; there was no semantic defect. The new rule is algebraically equivalent for binary centers: a dead center accepts only total 3, while a live center accepts totals 3 and 4."}
